inputs.projection: Web-Mercator, world = 512*2^z CSS px, north up, pitch 0 (pretty:97237-97250); zoom range of the app 11..18, start 13.5
inputs.units_note: All pixel sizes are CSS px at devicePixelRatio 1; the shipped canvas is not DPR-aware (perf-runtime-10).

models.A_carry_as_shipped: every unit with any keyframe <= t is drawn at its last keyframe, never removed (the app as shipped, forward play from tick 1)
models.B_latest_keyframe_snapshot: only the rows recorded at the most recent keyframe tick <= t, held until the next keyframe tick (the most generous honest reading; a strict exact-tick reading, as the overview counter was designed, would draw nothing on the 487 ticks that have no rows)
models.C_carry_window_24: carry-forward but a unit is dropped when its last keyframe is more than 24 ticks old (sensitivity probe only)

tile_footprints.today: shipped glyph: body w x h (w=clamp(round(strength/4),10,120), h=8, cavalry 4) + 3.5 px dot centred 7 px above; no label
tile_footprints.S_24x16: fixed 24x16 px probe (not a design decision)
tile_footprints.M_40x16: fixed 40x16 px probe (not a design decision)
tile_footprints.L_72x30: fixed 72x30 px probe (not a design decision)

metric_definitions.near: two tiles are within one tile-width when centre distance < W px; cluster = connected component of that graph
metric_definitions.overlap: two tiles obscure each other when their footprints intersect; cluster = connected component
metric_definitions.moves: min tiles to move/merge/hide so every remaining tile is fully visible on its true position = n - MIS; given as lb/ub
metric_definitions.merge_removed: sum over overlap clusters of (size-1): tiles that vanish if every cluster collapses to one badge
metric_definitions.weights: ticks: a state that persists for k ticks counts k times

zoom_independent.note: Ground distances in metres, independent of zoom. Placement coordinates carry 4 decimals = 11.1 m north-south, 8.5 m east-west. Stacks = tiles on an identical lat/lng pair: no zoom level separates them, so they must be merged or fanned out at every zoom. Ancestor/descendant = a brigade, division or corps tile and one of its own regiments both on the map (parents from data-src/build/unit_index.json; only the 383 placed ids that resolve are testable).

places_note.caveat: Production moved eight key locations by 166-733 m relative to legacy/dist (docs/baseline-drift.md). The placements were authored against an unknown reference; nearest_place is a label for the reader, not a claim that the cluster is at that place.
